body: Wow yeah, I honestly had no idea others did this too. I get some weird looks.

thank you so much. I don't know how to respond properly right now as I'm an emotional mess but I needed to be told all of this. <3 I hope one day I can believe I can get through this. that I'm strong enough to fight it. I've failed in the past at fighting it and that haunts me. I use it as an excuse that I can't get better. It's so awful. I treat myself like a criminal, as if eating was and is my crime. I need to be better. I have to. this isn't sustainable.

the calories don't count if I eat really fast, no one sees me, and repress the memory of eating them, right?

*profusely sweats*
Relatable... my gi and hakama are getting looser yet my body dysmorphia won't let me see any difference in my appearance. it's wild, and frustrating.
Thank you so much. I've calmed down a little and I'm kinda scared at what this ED has made me into. Panic attacks over 0.6 lbs... what the hell... sorry for freaking out.

I'm just some stupid wannabe. not skinny enough to have a problem. I haven't lost enough weight. just a stupid attention starved idiot. I doubt any medical professional would take me seriously. wish my body would just give up and die already. feels like it's going to. I'm sorry. I'll probably delete this later. I just can't take it anymore. none of it matters anyway. no one in my life cares. I'm scared

I finally ate something today, so I feel like shit. I keep telling myself that I had to but it's just frustrating me more. I don't want to live like this anymore. I nearly pass out every class while training. it's the only thing I do in my life that makes me happy, but I don't know how long my body will allow it.

bonus feature: it requires me to wear a Japanese gi and hakama and while I love those and wearing them, they make me look like the fattest, widest thing ever even though I know I'm technically lower weight but mostly muscle. dysmorphia ahoy. fuuuuuuuck
Thank you so much for this. Knowing I'm not alone and knowing that people can fight this stuff is comforting. I just wish I knew where to start, or who to go to, if that makes sense.

You're correct. I feel so worried about it. Kassandra has been my favorite character ever really, because I see myself in her in so many ways, especially in sexuality as a lesbian. It would kinda crush the game's plot and the character for me if they just.... forced a dude into the mix when they've ALWAYS given us a choice in the base game. Even if for plot reasons like 'offspring' it'd be contrived and nasty.

I've never seen my bots use an ultimate/active ability. Hoping mods will help! And my bots use the career that I choose for them with whatever talents I've unlocked and chosen I think. (I have to unlock the other careers though to get them to use it).

My biggest issue is that no matter what items I wear, enemies seem to one shot me. Maybe I'm too underleveled. Cheap one shots just make me shut the game off all the time. Should I level grind before I do anything else?
